title: Thanks to all who responded yesterday …
excerpt: … to my request for help .If you can’t help at this time, you might know someone who can … it would be great if you could forward the request to them. Over the weekend I’ll be responding to all who reply. Again, thanks. Response has been truly gratifying.
body: … to my request for help .If you can’t help at this time, you might know someone who can … it would be great if you could forward the request to them. Over the weekend I’ll be responding to all who reply. Again, thanks. Response has been truly gratifying.
